antithrombotic_choice_and_dosage.recommendation: Adapt choice and dosage of antithrombotic agent and secondary prevention medications to renal function, co-medications, comorbidities, frailty, cognitive function, and contraindications.

frail_older_patients.recommendation: For frail older patients with comorbidities, use a holistic approach to individualize interventional and pharmacological treatments after careful evaluation of risks and benefits.

invasive_strategy_for_cancer_patients.recommendation: An invasive strategy is recommended in cancer patients presenting with high-risk ACS with expected life survival ≥6 months.

temporary_interruption_of_cancer_therapy.recommendation: Temporary interruption of cancer therapy is recommended in patients in whom the cancer therapy is suspected to be a contributing cause of ACS.

aspirin_platelet_threshold.recommendation: Aspirin is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <10,000/µL.

clopidogrel_platelet_threshold.recommendation: Clopidogrel is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <30,000/µL.

prasugrel_ticagrelor_platelet_threshold.recommendation: In ACS patients with cancer and <50,000/µL platelet count, prasugrel or ticagrelor are not recommended.

cardiac_rehabilitation.recommendation: All ACS patients should participate in a medically supervised, structured, comprehensive, multidisciplinary exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation and prevention programme.

healthy_lifestyle_recommendations.recommendation: ACS patients should adopt a healthy lifestyle including stopping all smoking of tobacco, healthy (Mediterranean) diet, alcohol restriction, regular aerobic and resistance exercise, and reduced sedentary time.
components: regular aerobic physical activity and resistance exercise

lipid_lowering_therapy.recommendation: High-dose statin therapy is recommended to be initiated or continued as early as possible regardless of initial LDL-C values.
